dedupe_keys.name: bdew data and graphics german energy and water industry statistics including district heating gas and networks

description: BDEW, the German association of the energy and water industries, collects, analyses and prepares market and basic data of the sector and publishes them as data and graphics. The page read on the day of cataloguing offered state-level dossiers of maps, data and facts for the energy industry (30 June 2026) and the water industry (15 September 2025), and a keyword filter over topics such as renewables, district heating, investment, key figures, mobility, networks, drinking water, weather data, gas, electricity, housing and heating, generation, and sales and consumption. District heating items included district heating generation in Germany with district cooling, installed capacity and fuels (17 September 2026), district heating use by consumer group, district heating structure and market data, and the heat status report; other items covered energy networks in Germany (electricity, gas and district heating networks), natural gas sales and consumption, energy investment and the annual report on energy supply in 2025. Coverage is Germany and its states. Charts and publications are free to view online; no reuse licence is stated. Caveats: most content is charts and reports, not downloadable tables, and figures come from the association's own surveys. Simulation uses are national and state energy, gas and district heating statistics for energy system and heat planning models. Related records: data-energiforetagen-sweden-district-heating-statistics is a comparable industry source for Sweden.
